updateStatusUpToDate: You are on the latest version.
updateStatusCheckFailed: The check did not go through.
updateNoticeIos: iOS cannot update from inside the app. If you installed through TestFlight, update there; if you sideloaded with a free signature, the signature expires after 7 days and you need a computer to sideload the new .ipa again.
updateNoticeWeb: The web version updates with the server: a hard refresh (Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + R) is enough.
updateNoticeNoAssetForPlatform: This version has no downloadable package for your platform. You can get it manually from the GitHub Releases page.
updateNoticeMacos: On macOS you drag the new version into Applications yourself. Finder opens automatically once the download finishes.
updateIntegrityFull: Integrity: the file size matches, and the SHA-256 matches the checksum published in the release notes.
updateIntegritySizeOnly: Integrity: only the file size was checked against what GitHub reports. The release notes gave no checksum, so the contents cannot be verified; transport safety relies on HTTPS.
updateIntegrityNone: Integrity: nothing could be verified, the release gave no file size.
updateInstallConfirmBody:
Lares will close, replace its program files and start again on its own.
If you are talking in a circle, you will be disconnected first.
updateAutoCheckSubtitle: Checks quietly and only speaks up when there is a new version. Installing always needs your confirmation.
updateErrUnknownVersion: Could not make sense of the current version number ({version})
updateErrRateLimited: The GitHub API quota is used up (60 requests per hour when signed out). Try again later.
updateErrRateLimitedUntil: {minutes, plural, =1{The GitHub API quota is used up (60 requests per hour when signed out), it comes back in about 1 minute. Try again later.} other{The GitHub API quota is used up (60 requests per hour when signed out), it comes back in about {minutes} minutes. Try again later.}}
updateErrGithubRefused: GitHub turned down the request ({code}). Try again later.
updateErrNoReleases: The repository has no releases yet.
updateErrHttp: The check did not go through (HTTP {code}).
updateErrMalformed: The release data came back in an unexpected shape and could not be read.
updateErrTimeout: The network timed out, so updates cannot be checked right now.
updateErrOffline: No network connection, so updates cannot be checked right now.
updateErrNoAsset: There is no downloadable package for this platform.
updateErrSizeMismatch: The downloaded file is the wrong size (expected {expected} bytes, got {actual}), so it was deleted.
updateErrChecksum: The checksum does not match. The file may be damaged or tampered with, so it was deleted.
updateErrNotDownloaded: There is no downloaded package yet.
updateErrInstallFailed: The installation did not go through.
updateErrWinNoInstallDir: The install folder could not be found. You can download the new version and install over the old one yourself.
updateErrWinNotWritable: The install folder is not writable, usually because Lares sits in Program Files and is not running as administrator. Download the new version manually, or move Lares into your user folder and try again.
updateErrWinProbeFailed: Could not tell whether the install folder is writable: {detail}
updateErrWinPackageInvalid: The update package looks wrong ({name} was not in it). Nothing was changed, your current version is untouched.
updateWinRestarting: Quitting to finish the update, Lares comes back in a few seconds.
updateErrAndroidInstallerNotOpened: The system installer did not open.
updateErrAndroidLaunchFailed: Could not open the system installer: {detail}
updateAndroidInstallerOpened: The system installer is open. If it says installing unknown apps is blocked, allow Lares to install apps in the settings screen it offers, then try again.
updateErrIosNoSelfUpdate: iOS cannot update the app from inside itself. Update through TestFlight, or sideload the new .ipa from a computer.
updateErrIosCannotInstall: iOS cannot install an update package from inside the app.
